Question: who had the lowest earnings in the first year and fifth year after immigration respectively?
target:
<ROUTE>SQL</ROUTE>
<SQL>
WITH unpivoted AS (
  SELECT group_level_1 AS year, 'federal skilled workers' AS program, CAST(federal_skilled_workers AS INTEGER) AS earnings
  FROM my_table
  WHERE group_level_1 IN ('first full year after immigration', 'fifth year after immigration')
    AND Col_0 = 'all'
    AND federal_skilled_workers != 'None'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT group_level_1, 'provincial nominees', CAST(provincial_nominees AS INTEGER)
  FROM my_table
  WHERE group_level_1 IN ('first full year after immigration', 'fifth year after immigration')
    AND Col_0 = 'all'
    AND provincial_nominees != 'None'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT group_level_1, 'quebec skilled workers', CAST(quebec_skilled_workers AS INTEGER)
  FROM my_table
  WHERE group_level_1 IN ('first full year after immigration', 'fifth year after immigration')
    AND Col_0 = 'all'
    AND quebec_skilled_workers != 'None'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT group_level_1, 'canadian experience class', CAST(canadian_experience_class AS INTEGER)
  FROM my_table
  WHERE group_level_1 IN ('first full year after immigration', 'fifth year after immigration')
    AND Col_0 = 'all'
    AND canadian_experience_class != 'None'
)
SELECT year, program, earnings
FROM unpivoted
WHERE (year, earnings) IN (
  SELECT year, MIN(earnings)
  FROM unpivoted
  GROUP BY year
)
ORDER BY year;
</SQL>
